# Grokbot Templates

> A public directory of Grok Bot templates you can browse and install via x.ai.

## Pages

- [Discover](https://grokbot-templates.com): Grok Bot template catalog
- [Templates](https://grokbot-templates.com/templates): Filterable template list
- [Teams](https://grokbot-templates.com/teams): Agent team blueprints with install order
- [Content studio](https://grokbot-templates.com/teams/content-studio): Discovery in, drafts out. You still hit publish.
- [One-person desk](https://grokbot-templates.com/teams/one-person-desk): A company of one, with a chief of staff who never hits send.
- [GTM / sales](https://grokbot-templates.com/teams/gtm): Prospects, pain, and follow-ups — outbound stays a draft.
- [Trading research desk](https://grokbot-templates.com/teams/trading-research-desk): Paper and drafts only. You still arm every order.
- [Engineering build desk](https://grokbot-templates.com/teams/engineering-build): Code, review, and audit — you still merge.
- [Support / inbox desk](https://grokbot-templates.com/teams/support-inbox): Drafts never send without your approval.
- [Job seeker desk](https://grokbot-templates.com/teams/job-seeker-desk): Seeker-side. You still click apply.
- [Personal money ops](https://grokbot-templates.com/teams/personal-money-ops): Read-only money ops. No live trading.
- [Use cases](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases): Cited Grok Bot setups with published prompts
- [Twice → Skill; bots draft, Chief presents, you decide](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/twice-then-skill-chief-decides): The same job twice is a recipe — if someone else presents, you only approve what goes public.
- [Tip only: Gmail + Drive — find the emailed file, file it](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/gmail-drive-find-and-file): A colleague swears the file is missing from Drive — it was sitting in your mail.
- [Split jobs into three lanes; process must survive the move](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/three-lanes-survive-the-move): Loyalty to a model is not a process — if it only works in one tool, it was never a process.
- [Role bots + CoS: memory, tools, own computer — not one-off asks](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/cos-role-bots-memory-computer): One-off "do this" chats do not compound. Role bots that remember and route do.
- [Notion Skills API: edit in Notion, ship via GitHub, agents run](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/notion-edit-github-ship-agents-run): Skills lived on someone's laptop. Editors used GitHub. Non-engineers could not touch them.
- [Install bankr skill URL → Grok Bot can build a portfolio](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/bankr-skill-install-then-trade): A skill URL is not a license to buy. Install is setup; every fill still needs you.
- [Tip only: ban agent comments — they hide the hack](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/no-comments-skill-deletes-bandages): Agent comments are rarely for humans. They are cover for a hack that never gets fixed.
- [Yak voice bot: talk to Boss; specialists ask for a voice pass](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/yak-voice-via-boss-not-chat): Cryptic AI-sounding posts ship when nobody owns your voice — and you should not have to open a Yak chat to teach it.
- [Red Team bot outside the org chart: GO / CONDITIONS / NO-GO](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/red-team-outside-org-chart): Most bots help you move faster. The useful one sometimes exists to stop you.
- [YouTube / RSS / PDF → scheduled Markdown knowledge base](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/youtube-rss-pdf-to-markdown-kb): Links, channels, and papers pile up unless something fetches them on a schedule and files Markdown.
- [Tip only: dedicated mini Chrome when sites block Grok Bot](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/dedicated-mini-chrome-for-blocked-sites): Some storefronts block the bot user-agent. A registered mini opening Chrome is the author's stated workaround.
- [Galaxy lesson: one company story, a CoS, one annoying job](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/one-story-cos-one-annoying-job): Watching a build tempts you to spawn more bots. The lesson was the opposite.
- [Tip only: Thunderbird on the bot VM for mail + calendar](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/thunderbird-on-vm-for-mail-cal): Mail and calendar can live on the bot computer. iMessage still needs a screenshot workaround.
- [Galaxy crib: blank slate, wedge, overnight computers, humans decide](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/galaxy-week-four-remember): A three-day livestream dumps more than you can steal unless you keep a four-line spine.
- [Write the Teams channel fence before you OAuth](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/teams-channel-fence-before-oauth): Workplace chat connectors are useful — and they are a blast radius.
- [Gustaf orchestrates Growth specialists; you still approve the go](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/coderhouse-growth-gustaf-fleet): Growth work scatters across paid, CRO, SEO, email, Slack — and you become the router.
- [Tip only: Alley Cat hunts 1–3 tools; House Cat keeps fleet morale](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/alley-cat-house-cat-doorstep): Forty-seven research tabs is not a hunt — it is tab rot.
- [Tip only: yesterday's Gong notes shape today's outbound](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/gong-notes-into-outbound-email): The pain they said out loud on an AE call dies in the transcript.
- [Defensive security advisor: harden, watch news, refuse exploits](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/security-advisor-defensive-watch): AI features ship without a hardening pass, then news hits a stack you never mapped.
- [Portco updates via Qualabi KB + Grok Bot MCP](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/portco-qualabi-mcp-bi-loop): Portfolio updates live in ten inboxes; the important items never reach the right person.
- [Tip only: Claude/Cursor webhook-wakes Grok Bot with natural language](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/claude-cursor-webhook-to-grok-bot): Most people only think Grok → Grok Bot. Other coding AIs can ring the same doorbell.
- [Tip only: watch a poster, queue post + screenshot + share link](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/watch-poster-share-link-desk): A favorite poster skips original links — you lose the source before you can share it well.
- [Galaxy Day 2 crib: Connect stack + one job + routine](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/galaxy-day2-sales-formula-crib): Day 2 sales slides evaporate unless you steal a three-beat formula.
- [Galaxy Day 2 ops crib: end-to-end, bot-to-bot, add only for E2E](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/galaxy-day2-stealables-crib): A pile of single-task bots still makes you prompt every seat.
- [Counsel frames the open question; EXECUTE/HANDOFF unlocks action](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/counsel-before-execute-handoff): Grok Bot is strong once you know the job — weak at helping you frame it the first time.
- [CS crawl→walk→run: Build / Reply / Alert / Tune, refunds stay human](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/cs-build-reply-alert-tune): Support wants a fleet on day one — start with one bot or the scope eats you.
- [Two email desks: inbox cleaner on a schedule + AgentMail webhook wake](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/natey-agentmail-dual-inbox): One bot buried in your personal inbox cannot also be a clean address for outside work.
- [Lead bot only triages; specialists touch the screen](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/lead-triage-never-touches-screen): A mega lead bot that both routes and executes becomes the bottleneck and the risk.
- [Ashley up the funnel → Pete PRD → Pixel → humans → Emily → code → QA](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/ashley-funnel-handoff-chain): Teams add more bots instead of fixing where the work should hand off.
- [Galaxy Day 1 crib: colleagues > mega-bot, away mode, teach from real threads](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/galaxy-day1-stealables-crib): Livestream lessons evaporate unless you steal a short, tryable crib.
- [New bots read a founding doc first; research stays cited and read-only](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/founding-doc-before-new-bots): A 15-bot crew without a shared plan cold-outreaches and drifts off mission.
- [Tip only: let bots pick Notion DB vs Obsidian markdown](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/bots-pick-notion-or-obsidian): Forcing every note into one tool fights how the work actually wants to be stored.
- [Author-quoted Flylo trio: Cora CoS, Pete PM, Ashley analyst](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/flylo-cora-pete-ashley-prompts): Galaxy showed Cora / Pete / Ashley roles, but most people leave without copy-pasteable seats.
- [Tip only: scrape season events → Google Calendar leave reminders](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/sport-season-to-gcal-leave): Kids' sport schedules live on messy web pages while your calendar stays empty.
- [Analytics Bot → Notion DB → drafts that do not repeat last week](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/analytics-notion-content-week): AI drafts guess what resonates because they never see your last week of numbers.
- [Yeoman: knowledge layer first; file plan before any edit](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/yeoman-knowledge-before-tools): Bots with the right tools still work from the wrong business context.
- [Ten agents: Memory + Verification before anything ships](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/ten-agent-verify-then-publish): One mega-assistant restarts from zero and ships weak claims.
- [Coding agent finished a PR — webhook handoff to Grok Bot](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/pr-handoff-webhook-to-grok): Repo work ends in the coding agent; desktop smoke tests and ops never get a clean handoff.
- [Ten GTM recipes: personal hooks, intent sheets, live recap decks](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/gtm-ten-recipes-from-kristaletz): Enterprise GTM still hunts company news while personal hooks and closed-loop asks sit unused.
- [Tip only: design-resource inbox — drop a link, ask later](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/lienzo-design-resource-inbox): Design links pile up in bookmarks and chats with no durable, searchable library.
- [GTM desk: connectors first, screen-record teach, async finish](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/gtm-connectors-screen-record-async): Sales bots stall when every step needs you in the browser mid-meeting.
- [Seven answers before you name a Grok Bot](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/seven-answers-before-name): People name a bot first, then burn a week discovering what it should not do.
- [Poshmark crew: Poshy sells, Cosie watches, Weary archives](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/poshmark-role-split-crew): One mega-bot tries to list, price, haggle, and tidy wardrobe — then drops a step.
- [Midnight scorecard: which X posts won yesterday](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/midnight-x-post-scorecard): You post all day and never get a calm read on what actually worked.

- [Route long video to Gemini, then edit from the brief](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/gemini-video-brief-skill): Most agents still can't watch a long video with real attention.
- [Strava + Oura → always-on Mac markdown for the bot](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/strava-oura-mac-markdown): Watch and ring data never land where Grok Bot can read them.
- [Tip only: continue on the Gmail thread where you started](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/email-thread-as-agent-surface): One chat wall per topic gets confusing fast.
- [One shared box: CoS dispatch, artifacts, human on the irreversible five](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/shared-box-handoff-by-artifact): More bots is not what the official guide asked for.
- [ChatGPT review dispatcher + Grok CoS when the laptop is closed](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/chatgpt-review-dispatcher-sdlc): The loop dies when you close the lid — unless review is scheduled elsewhere.
- [Build X three-panel Figma photomosaics with Grok Bot](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/figma-photomosaic-three-panel): Three-panel mosaics look simple and eat a designer's afternoon on Auto Layout tweaks.
- [Audit recurring spend with a ledger and human money gate](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/procurement-spend-audit-ledger): Teams see what got charged, not which renewals still deserve a decision.
- [Add a Contrastive Inquiry bot that forces the inverse](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/contrastive-inquiry-adversary): Hand a bot a plan and it executes. Bad ideas need an adversary, not a cheerleader.
- [Tip only: turn one finished job into a Skill recipe](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/skill-from-one-finished-job): People treat Skills like long prompt dumps instead of a replayable judgment recipe.
- [List unused stuff with a hard floor; human still owns payment creds](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/marketplace-sell-floor-price): Skeptics will not hand payment credentials to an agent — selling is a safer first experiment.
- [Trading desk: lane bots ship facts, only Lead synthesizes](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/facts-lanes-then-lead): If every research bot can also call the trade, bias leaks into the entry.
- [Pick the computer (hostname) before you pick the model](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/pick-hostname-before-model): Same chat font on three disks — wrong hostname looks like a confident missing-tool error.
- [Daily Upwork shortlist + drafts; you still hit send](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/upwork-drafts-human-send): Agency applications burn Connects and read like AI slop if the bot auto-sends.
- [Anti-AI skill: fail the draft before you send](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/anti-ai-tweet-gate): "Banger" drafts still read like AI and die on your desk.
- [Codex finishes → checklist → Grok Bot Notion page](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/codex-checklist-to-notion): Big agent runs leave you with no concrete test list in Notion.
- [Local Hermes drives cloud Grok Bot via webhook](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/hermes-webhook-drive-grok): Tailscale on the Grok Bot box is flaky; local Hermes still needs the cloud bot.
- [Five questions before you turn a task into a routine](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/five-qs-before-routine): Automating a weak workflow just runs the bug on a schedule.
- [Build ships the app; Bot runs the company](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/build-vs-bot-surfaces): One chat for code, inbox, stills, and publishing burns tokens and ships half a company.
- [CEO bot + lane specialists; nothing ships without you](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/ceo-lane-bots-approval): Every chat tries to do every job — and invents who to contact next.
- [From iPhone: Bot drives your Mac into a Grok Build session](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/phone-drive-mac-build): You want local Build depth while you're away from the laptop keyboard.
- [Overnight agents finish in a review queue, not a write](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/overnight-finish-review-queue): Morning cleanup means the overnight agent crossed your irreversible line.
- [Researcher seat: cite or stop](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/researcher-cite-or-stop): Confident answers with zero sources ship, then you cannot defend them.
- [Tip only: Microsoft Teams plugin (Entra OAuth)](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/teams-plugin-entra): You want Grok Bot in Teams chats without inventing a connector.
- [LinkedIn reply triage that protects the founder calendar](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/linkedin-protect-founder-calendar): "Sure" replies get a calendar link before anyone checks fit.
- [Tip only: pull skills and rewrite the auto-bloat](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/rewrite-auto-bloated-skills): Grok Bot keeps padding skills with extra examples until it slows and confuses itself.
- [X Poster + Publisher: ideas for the week, you still approve](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/x-poster-publisher-weekly-approve): You want weekday posts without waking Saturday to write them.
- [Scheduled X account health check (follows + engagement)](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/x-account-health-check-routine): Mutual follows vanish and high-signal topics get buried in the feed.
- [One group-chat room per project; Notion when seats fill](https://grokbot-templates.com/use-cases/project-room-standup-not-brain): One mega-agent chat becomes the brain and every project collides.
